train_unsupervised_skipgram: train an unsupervised skipgram word embedding model from a text corpus file
save_model_binary: save a trained fasttext model to a binary file for later loading
get_word_vector: get the vector representation of a word from a trained fasttext model
compute_similarity: compute Spearman correlation between model cosine similarities and human similarity judgments
evaluate_word_similarity: evaluate a fasttext model's word similarity against a gold standard dataset
